input: Which of Quillmoor Capital, Vellisk Partners and Orrindale Fund has the strongest fintech track record? Give numbers.

rounds.answer:
**Quillmoor Capital has the strongest fintech track record** of the three, going by portfolio counts.

| Firm | Fintech companies | Total portfolio | Active since |
|---|---|---|---|
| Quillmoor Capital | 6 | 6 (all fintech) | Founded 2014; investments from 2019 to 2026 |
| Vellisk Partners | 2 | 2 (all fintech) | Founded 2018; investments in 2022 and 2024 |
| Orrindale Fund | 1 | 2 (the other is proptech) | Founded 2020; investments in 2023 and 2024 |

Quillmoor has made fintech investments in six different years, including one in 2026.

The dataset has no figures for returns, exits or valuations. This comparison covers only the number and timing of investments.
